public_rationale: ARC Prize's report says 'OpenAI shared they trained the o3 we tested on 75% of the Public Training set'. It describes the scored system as 'trained on the ARC-AGI-1 Public Training set'. So the tested o3 did not take the test cold with only a few sample items as a human would. It had been trained beforehand on hundreds of public ARC tasks. Training on a benchmark's training split is common practice, but the factual point Marcus made holds.
limitations: How listeners understood the video is not assessed.
Each evaluation task still gave o3 only a few demonstration pairs. The difference lies in the earlier training on ARC data.
